A. Ella gets up at seven. She has a shower, eats breakfast and walks to school with her brother. She never takes the bus because their home is near the school.

B. Jack gets up at half past six. He usually eats toast and catches the 7:40 bus. He reads a comic on the bus, but he does not use his phone.

C. Nina gets up at seven fifteen. She feeds her cat before breakfast. Her dad drives her to school when it rains, but she often walks with a friend.
